title: Conditionals 1: zero, first, second
subtitle: Facts, likely futures, and imaginary present or future situations

blocks.text: Some sentences with the word **if** are called conditional sentences. With every conditional sentence, there are two parts: a situation and the result of that situation. It is the situation that starts with **if**. There are different types of conditional sentence, depending on what the situation is.

items: When we start the sentence with **if**, we separate the situation and the result with a comma: **If** you join a gym, I'll join too.
When we start the sentence with the result, we don't use a comma: I'll join too **if** you join a gym.

rows.example: If people **eat** too much, they often **get** fat.

rows.use: Real or likely situations in the present or future and their results
rows.example: If you **take** these pills, you'll **start** to feel better very soon.

blocks.intro: We can also use other modals instead of **will**, depending on the meaning. We can also use an imperative instead of **will** to give instructions.
items: If you get some rest, you **might** feel better tomorrow.
If you don't feel well, **go** home!

rows.use: Impossible or unlikely situations in the present or future and their results
rows.example: If my legs **were** longer, I **would be** a much faster runner!

blocks.intro: We can also use the second conditional to give advice. We use the phrases **If I were you ...** or **If I was you ...** for this. **If I were you ...** is more formal than **If I was you ...** .
items: If I **were** you, I would eat less chocolate. (more formal)
If I **was** you, I'd eat less chocolate! (more informal)

exercises.title: A · Zero conditional pictures
exercises.instruction: Look at the prompts and complete the sentences. Use the zero conditional.

items.prompt: you / heat / water / it / boil
acceptedAnswers: If you heat water, it boils.
If you heat water, it boils
If you heat water it boils.

items.prompt: you / send / an e-mail / it / be / free
acceptedAnswers: If you send an e-mail, it is free.
If you send an e-mail, it is free
If you send an email, it is free.
If you send an email, it's free.
If you send an e-mail, it's free.

items.prompt: it / be / dangerous / you / not / wear / a seatbelt
acceptedAnswers: It is dangerous if you don't wear a seatbelt.
It is dangerous if you don't wear a seatbelt
It's dangerous if you don't wear a seatbelt.
It's dangerous if you don't wear a seatbelt
If you don't wear a seatbelt, it is dangerous.
If you don't wear a seatbelt, it's dangerous.

items.prompt: you / have / an injection / it / not / usually / hurt
acceptedAnswers: If you have an injection, it doesn't usually hurt.
If you have an injection, it doesn't usually hurt
If you have an injection, it does not usually hurt.

items.prompt: you / not / water / plants and flowers / they / die
acceptedAnswers: If you don't water plants and flowers, they die.
If you don't water plants and flowers, they die
If you do not water plants and flowers, they die.

items.prompt: the sea / not / be / calm / not / be / safe / to swim
acceptedAnswers: If the sea isn't calm, it isn't safe to swim.
If the sea isn't calm, it isn't safe to swim
If the sea is not calm, it is not safe to swim.
If the sea isn't calm, it's not safe to swim.

exercises.title: B · Correct the bold words
exercises.instruction: The words and phrases in bold in each sentence are wrong. Write the correct word or phrase.

items.prompt: If we **will go** shopping tomorrow, I'll probably buy a new top.
acceptedAnswers: If we go shopping tomorrow, I'll probably buy a new top.

items.prompt: If Mum is tired tonight, I **cook** dinner.
acceptedAnswers: If Mum is tired tonight, I'll cook dinner.
If Mum is tired tonight, I will cook dinner.

items.prompt: John **will tell** us if there **will be** any news.
acceptedAnswers: will tell us if there is
John will tell us if there is any news.
John will tell us if there is any news

items.prompt: If I **won't get** a good mark in the geography test, I'll be very annoyed!
acceptedAnswers: If I don't get a good mark in the geography test, I'll be very annoyed!
If I don't get a good mark in the geography test, I'll be very annoyed

items.prompt: You **are tired** in the morning if you don't go to bed soon.
acceptedAnswers: You'll be tired in the morning if you don't go to bed soon.
You will be tired in the morning if you don't go to bed soon.

items.prompt: If you see Karen, **do you** ask her to call me?
acceptedAnswers: If you see Karen, will you ask her to call me?
If you see Karen, will you ask her to call me

items.prompt: **Does** Frank come with us if we go to the beach at the weekend?
acceptedAnswers: Will Frank come with us if we go to the beach at the weekend?
Will Frank come with us if we go to the beach at the weekend

items.prompt: If you need help, **will tell** me!
acceptedAnswers: If you need help, tell me!
If you need help, tell me

exercises.title: C · First conditional
exercises.instruction: Complete using the correct form of the verbs in brackets.

items.prompt: If I ___ well in the exam, my parents will buy me an MP3 player. (do)
If my sister borrows my clothes again, I ___ ! (scream)
We'll leave at six o'clock if the weather ___ bad. (be)
They ___ if we're a bit late this afternoon. (not / mind)
Sarah will be very annoyed if Dave ___ her this evening. (not / call)
Will you still go to the concert if the tickets ___ 60 euros? (cost)
If Rania doesn't come to the party, ___ Greg upset? (be)
I'll be surprised if Doug and Dana ___ a new car soon. (not / get)

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct word or phrase.

___ go on a cruise if they had enough money.
You'd feel a lot healthier if you ___ eat so much fast food.
If I ___ a bike, it wouldn't take me so long to get to school.
If you met Tom Hanks, what ___ you ask him?
___ Bobby be upset if I didn't invite him?

exercises.title: E · Rewrite with if
exercises.instruction: Complete each second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence. Write no more than three words.

items.prompt:
Sylvia doesn't have enough money, so she can't buy a new computer.
If Sylvia ___ enough money, she'd buy a new computer.
acceptedAnswers: If Sylvia had enough money, she'd buy a new computer.
If Sylvia had enough money, she would buy a new computer.

items.prompt:
The twins don't see their friends often because they're very busy.
If the twins weren't so busy, they ___ their friends more often.
acceptedAnswers: If the twins weren't so busy, they would see their friends more often.

items.prompt:
I don't live in a city, so there's not much to do in the evening.
If I ___ in a city, there would be lots to do in the evening.
acceptedAnswers: If I lived in a city, there would be lots to do in the evening.

items.prompt:
Grandma won't get a dog because she lives in a small flat.
If Grandma ___ in a small flat, she'd get a dog.
acceptedAnswers: If Grandma didn't live in a small flat, she'd get a dog.

items.prompt:
You use your mobile a lot, so you have large phone bills.
If you didn't use your mobile so much, you ___ large phone bills.
acceptedAnswers: If you didn't use your mobile so much, you wouldn't have large phone bills.

items.prompt:
I think you should tell your parents the truth.
If I ___ you, I'd tell your parents the truth.
acceptedAnswers: If I were you, I'd tell your parents the truth.
If I was you, I'd tell your parents the truth.

exercises.title: F · Letters about vegetarianism
exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for each gap.

items.prompt: Yuri: 'I'm thinking of becoming a vegetarian, but some of my friends say it's a bad idea. They say that if I (1) ___ eating meat, my body won't get all the things it needs to stay healthy.'

Marsha: 'Millions of people are vegetarians and they're perfectly healthy. You have to be careful, though. If you (2) ___ up eating meat completely, and only ate chocolate and crisps, that would obviously be very bad for you!'
If you gave up eating meat completely, and only (3) ___ chocolate and crisps, that would obviously be very bad for you!
If people don't eat properly, they (4) ___ ill. It's that simple.
If you eat lots of fruit and salad and beans, you (5) ___ get all the things you need to stay healthy.
But — you're only 14 years old. If you (6) ___ at home with your parents — and you probably do — you'll have to ask them what they think too.
If your mum cooks for you, it (7) ___ be difficult for her to make you special meals.
If I were you, I (8) ___ think about this carefully and maybe wait until you're a bit older before making such a big decision.
